items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So I went down and sat in with Alonzo and Ira and Oscar, and we all... Because we was all about the same age.

ctx.x: I guess the trumpet player was named Ira -- Ira Pettiford?
Yeah, Ira. That was one. And he had another brother named Alonzo who played trumpet. And he was out of sight, too, man. He was very good. I think he got TB and died or something.
Did you know the father, Doc Pettiford?
